findings.description: [AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] app/apis/auth/services/get_token_service.py: authentication outcomes are emitted as structured audit() events carrying actor, actor_role and a reason (locked_out / invalid_credentials); the submitted password is never passed to the logger and the audit_log field allow-list drops it regardless. No request object, Pydantic model or Authorization header is logged wholesale | verdict=pass confidence=high

[AI-SAST via Code Scan Verification Validation | claude-opus-5] app/init_app.py: configure_logging() installs structured logging before the app is built, and AccessAuditMiddleware records every refusal (401/403/429), every 5xx and every state-changing method with method, path, status_code and client_ip. request.url.path is logged deliberately instead of the full URL so reset codes or tokens in a query string are not copied into the log - the same no-secrets-in-logs property as the recommended redaction step | verdict=pass confidence=high
